description: Hash text or bytes: SHA-1/2/3, Keccak-256, MD5, RIPEMD-160, BLAKE2/3. Computes one or all of md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3-256, sha3-512, keccak256, ripemd160, blake2b-256/512, blake2s-256, blake3. Input as UTF-8 text, hex, base64 or base58; output hex or base64. Up to 1 MB. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
